scope: Unpublished whole-placement add/copy/remove in one ordinary registered recipe source document. No author-format or backend-protocol changes, release, commit, installation or Android-device acceptance.
behavior: Add an existing fragment, including previously unused fragments, with fresh placement and complete actor/group identity maps.
Copy the original placement CST span, replacing only identity value tokens; preserve offsets, declaration absence, local overrides/null, key order and numeric lexemes.
Remove one complete placement while retaining at least one placement; removal may remove the current preview opener actor.
Independent optional Rust placements_version=1 and pure proposal/prepare APIs; absence disables only the new editor.
Complete source-owned preview and all actor/group provenance are checked before application to memory. Ordinary Save alone writes author files and retains external-conflict guards.

runtime.scope: Pinned sidecar seeded from declared archive to satisfy native build prerequisites; desktop prepare later verifies complete resources.

faultInjections: One valid HTTP response has its last sourceLocations.groups entry removed before delivery.
A real HTTP response is held, then its child is forcibly closed and the parent preview is closed; an actual visible source edit changes ownership before response delivery.
Capability phases wrap only the new WASM capability export at page boot; every other export and all HTTP/DOM controllers remain real.
flowAssertions: An unused fragment becomes a first placement with explicit fresh maps; its previously unconsumed projection image is checked by real complete preview, missing bytes reject approval, and Cancel preserves all author files.

ADD keeps one UUID allocation during raw input changes, repeated review and three 390px languages; projection, image, nested identity provenance and offset are complete. Silent unreviewed input is refused; Apply changes memory and ordinary Save preserves BOM/CRLF.

COPY appends two full nested-group placements with fresh complete maps, retaining every six-field local override, absent versus explicit-zero offset, escaped keys and exponent tokens byte-for-byte except identity values. A deliberately corrupted group provenance receipt is rejected, then retry succeeds and saved reopen retains identities.

REMOVE may remove the placement containing the selected opener. Complete actor/group mappings and local overrides disappear together; shared raw fragments and every other placement span remain unchanged. Cancel and ordinary Save/reopen both retain their proper source state.

A held real candidate arriving after dialog and source ownership change never reopens or replaces the new visible draft and is released by the HTTP host; this is an explicit asynchronous fault injection.
The last remaining placement cannot be removed; the independent one-placement recipe stays byte-identical.

With only the new WASM capability absent or unsupported, the placement-structure entry is disabled while five previous recipe editors still open and cancel through their real helpers; no author or backend build writes occur.

Ordinary Save detects a concurrent external recipe write and preserves both the reviewed local draft and exact external disk bytes. Original OC, projections, media, metadata and independent last-placement fixture stay untouched.

prepared.scope: Actual prepared copies in standard VM without Node/DOM/fetch/process globals; not a hostile-code sandbox, installation or device proof.

sharedCoreChanges: src/lib.rs dispatcher and new optional capability

limits: Existing 128 KiB and 128 expanded actor/group/placement budgets
No fragment/group definition structure editor, spatial transforms, nested/cross-file fragments, multi-file transaction or cross-view history
No executable recipe build, new backend adapter/runtime protocol or new installed desktop/mobile acceptance
